adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb, the migration does `execute(...)[0]['id'].to_i` when looking up the embed category via a join on `site_settings.value = categories.name`. If the SELECT returns zero rows (fresh install with no `embed_category` row, or if the configured category name no longer matches due to rename/deletion), `execute(...)[0]` is nil and `nil['id']` raises NoMethodError, aborting the migration before the later `if category_id == 0` fallback can run.
